classification.difficultyReason: Identify the two squared terms and use the explicitly requested middle-term strategy to add and subtract their double product.

content.prompt:
Complete the square of the following by adding the $2ab$ term.
$$25+\frac1{4t^2}$$

answer.worked:
For $t\ne0$, the middle term is $2(5)\left(\frac1{2t}\right)=\frac5t$.
$$\begin{align*}25+\frac1{4t^2}&=25+\frac5t+\frac1{4t^2}-\frac5t\\25+\frac1{4t^2}&=\left(5+\frac1{2t}\right)^2-\frac5t.\end{align*}$$
Alternatively:
$$\begin{align*}25+\frac1{4t^2}&=25-\frac5t+\frac1{4t^2}+\frac5t\\25+\frac1{4t^2}&=\left(5-\frac1{2t}\right)^2+\frac5t.\end{align*}$$
